cards.name: Reflective Plating
cards.description: +15 shield, and whatever the shield absorbs, the nearest enemy takes back at 150%.

cards.name: Quick Bastion
cards.description: Reduces shield recharge delay by 40%.

cards.name: Fortified Aegis
cards.description: The ward is forged in metal: +50% max shield capacity and +1 Metal tag, for 12% slower recharge.

cards.name: Sun Aegis
cards.description: Double shield capacity and +1 Light tag; a breaking shield flashes, staggering and weakening everything close.

cards.name: Thorn Crystal Shell
cards.description: +40 shield, and a breaking shield bursts into crystal shards that cut everything close for twice its size.

cards.name: Dual Shockwave
cards.description: The blast hits 35% harder and throws enemies 70% further.

cards.name: Static Nova
cards.description: The blast crackles with static: +20% damage, +1 Lightning tag, and hits stagger for 0.3 s.

cards.name: Lingering Rift
cards.description: Each blast leaves a rift on the ground for 2.5s that hurts what stands in it (+40% Area).

cards.name: Supernova
cards.description: A massive blast: +150% Area and +120% Damage.

cards.name: Event Horizon
cards.description: Cosmic singularity pulls enemies inward and freezes them for 2.5 seconds (+80% Area, +120% Damage).

cards.name: Crushing Grip
cards.description: The tentacles hold what they hit: every slap leaves a coil wound round its target's legs that roots it for 2 seconds. +50% slap damage.

cards.name: Fling
cards.description: The tentacles throw what they catch: a slap that lands picks its target up and hurls it across the pit at the enemy furthest from it, and where it comes down it and everything round it take 45% of a slap. Elites and bosses are too heavy to throw. +1 tentacle, the rift 20% wider.

cards.name: Soul Drain
cards.description: Every 4th slap that lands tears a wisp of life out of what it struck; it flies to you and heals 1 HP as it arrives, up to 3 HP a cast.

cards.name: Elder God Maw
cards.description: A vast maw opens instead of a rift (+50% size), ringed with eyes. It drags everything inside toward its teeth, and its tentacles slap for +200% damage.

cards.name: Shadow Forest
cards.description: The rift breaks into a forest of seven small pits over a field half again as wide, each with its own arms. It opens 44% sooner, and its tentacles slap for +120% damage.

cards.name: Burrs
cards.description: Thorns cling: whatever walks out of the thicket carries burrs for 2.5s that slow it and prick it for 50% of a thorn's bite. +25% damage, and the thicket grows 15% wider.

cards.name: Runners
cards.description: Once half grown, the thicket sends 3 thorned runners creeping over the ground to the nearest enemies past its rim; whatever stands on one is cut and slowed as if inside. Grows 25% faster.

cards.name: Ironbriar
cards.description: The thorns grow iron: +20% damage, +1 Metal tag, and the first hit Withers 5% of an enemy's max HP.

cards.name: Bramble Keep
cards.description: One great thicket three times as wide, ringed by a hedge of thorns that cuts 150% harder and slows to a crawl. It stands while you stay inside it; walk out, and the next cast sows a new keep at your feet. +80% damage.

cards.name: Thornstorm
cards.description: Every grown thicket throws a ring of 24 thorns out to 2x its width every 0.8s, hitting whatever they fly through. 2 more thickets may stand at once, -30% cooldown, +70% damage.

cards.name: Storm Surge
cards.description: The arc forks through falling rain: it splits three ways at every hop for 30% less each, +1 Water tag, and hits slow by 25% for 1.5 s.

cards.name: Storm Reach
cards.description: The chain leaps long: every hop jumps to the farthest enemy it can reach instead of the nearest, so the arc sprawls across the whole pack. 3 more hops and a 35% longer leap, for 15% less a hop.

cards.name: Return Stroke
cards.description: Where the chain ends, the stroke runs back along it to your hand, striking every enemy on the way again for 80%. +30% damage.

cards.name: Cascade
cards.description: The chain comes apart on what it kills: every enemy a hop kills flashes and throws 2 more arcs out of its body, up to 12 a cast, so a pack it can kill is torn through by a branching storm. Hops leap 30% further and hit 50% harder.

cards.name: Electrocution
cards.description: The first enemy the bolt strikes is held in the current for 1.2s, convulsing as arcs crawl over it, struck again every 0.2s for 40% of the bolt; if it dies held, the current leaps to the nearest enemy and holds that. +50% damage and one more hop.

cards.name: Backdraft
cards.description: Every burn ends in a backdraft: as the jet goes out, its fire rolls back into a burst at the tip that scorches everything round it for 3x a tongue's damage. +35% damage.

cards.name: Ember Wake
cards.description: The jet leaves embers on the ground: every second tongue drops one where it goes out, and the cone it swept burns for 2s, scorching whatever walks in for 50% of a tongue every half second. Tongues thrown 25% faster.

cards.name: Hellbreath
cards.description: The fire burns black: +20% damage, +1 Darkness tag, and hits leave enemies Vulnerable (+10% damage taken) for 2 s.

cards.name: Dragon's Breath
cards.description: A dragon's breath: the jet reaches 75% farther with tongues twice as wide, and where each burn ends a wall of fire rises across its path and stands 3s, burning whatever crosses it. +80% damage.

cards.name: Fire Fan
cards.description: It breathes 3 jets at once, fanned out, each turned on its own enemy in its own direction. -50% recharge between burns, every hit +90% damage.

cards.name: Deep Freeze
cards.description: Enemies hit by the cone are frozen solid for 1.2 seconds.

cards.name: Arctic Blast
cards.description: The cone opens into a half-moon: the ice sprays 180 degrees across the front of you instead of 60, and reaches 40% farther.

cards.name: Frost Shrapnel
cards.description: Meltwater runs through the cone: +30% damage and +1 Water tag.

cards.name: Zero Point Shockwave
cards.description: The cold gathers at the tip of the cone into a star of ice and bursts on: a second cone, as wide and 50% as long, is thrown on from that point into what stood behind the front. The cone reaches 40% farther, +120% damage.

cards.name: Glacier Tide
cards.description: The blast goes out as a wall of ice that throws everything it hits away from you. +100% damage.

cards.name: Fever Burst
cards.description: A carrier that dies bursts into a fever cloud: everything in the jump is hit for 60%, carrier or not, and the cloud hangs where it fell for 1.5s, infecting whatever walks into it. +25% damage.

cards.name: Outbreak
cards.description: The plague breaks out at once: the first carrier bursts the moment it is infected, spreading it through its own pack, and still jumps again when it dies.

cards.name: Marsh Fever
cards.description: The plague travels by water: +20% damage, +1 Water tag, and hits slow by 25% for 3 s.

cards.name: Pandemic
cards.description: Every 2s, every carrier on the field bursts at once without dying: each burst infects what is round it and hits it for 100%. The marks swell before each beat. Jumps 50% farther, +80% damage.

cards.name: Plague Wind
cards.description: Each cast also looses a cloud of the plague that drifts out from you through the crowd for 5s, infecting everything it passes. Each plague can reach 8 more enemies, -40% cooldown, +60% damage.

cards.name: Twin Gyres
cards.description: A second, inner ring of 3 blades whirls the other way round you, holding tight whatever the gust does: when you run and the outer ring swings wide, what slips through the gap still meets a blade. +1 blade on the outer ring, which spins 30% faster.

cards.name: Razor Gale
cards.description: The blades are edged in steel: +35% damage, +1 Metal tag, and the first hit Withers 4% of an enemy's max HP.

cards.name: Wind Shear
cards.description: At a full gust the blades shed crescents of wind: in turn, each flings one off along its spin every 0.6 s, and it flies on past the ring, cutting everything it crosses for 60% of a cut. Stop and it stops. The blades spin 25% faster.

cards.name: Typhoon Core
cards.description: A permanent hurricane: the ring never falls in when you stop, it stands at its widest round you, and it is two and a half times the size. +100% damage.

cards.name: Vortex Reaper
cards.description: The whirlwind drags the crowd round it in to the blades, and they cut harder. +150% damage.

cards.name: Grimalkin
cards.description: It grows old and wise, a witch's cat: everything it grants you is 40% stronger. +1 Arcane tag.

cards.name: Cait Sith
cards.description: The cat comes back from the fairy hills: +20% damage, +1 Darkness tag, and hits leave enemies Vulnerable (+25% damage taken) for 3 s.

cards.name: Purr
cards.description: It purrs at your heel: you mend 0.8 HP a second while it is out.

cards.name: Cath Palug
cards.description: It grows into the monstrous cat of the old tale: everything it grants you is 50% stronger again, and its swipes tear 60% wider and land 50% harder. +1 Arcane tag.

cards.name: Nine Lives
cards.description: The cat gives one of its lives for yours: +1 life. When you would fall, you stand back up with half your health.

cards.name: Raven
cards.description: It grows into a raven of your light: +30% damage, and its beak strikes 80% wider, taking what stands beside its quarry. +1 Arcane tag.

cards.name: Stormcrow
cards.description: The crow flies out of the storm: +20% damage, +1 Lightning tag, and hits stagger for 0.2 s.

cards.name: Murder of Crows
cards.description: The flock grows: +1 crow, each with its own quarry; every crow pecks 10% softer.

cards.name: The Morrigan
cards.description: It becomes the battle-crow that chooses who falls: a peck on an enemy under 30% of its health kills it outright, and on an elite or a boss there lands 2 times over. +100% damage, +1 Arcane tag.

cards.name: Griffin
cards.description: It grows into a griffin: a swoop through its quarry and on past it, striking everything along its line (a wider line with Area) for +20% damage. Swoops come 30% less often than pecks.

cards.name: Great Hound
cards.description: It grows into a great hound in the wizard's mantle: +20% damage, jaws 40% wider to maul what stands beside its quarry. +1 Arcane tag.

cards.name: Rimehound
cards.description: The hound runs cold: +20% damage, +1 Ice tag, and hits slow by 30% for 1.5 s. Frost breath: jaws 40% wider.

cards.name: Littermates
cards.description: Another hound answers the call: +1 hound, each with its own quarry; every hound bites 15% softer.

cards.name: Cerberus
cards.description: Three heads: every bite is 3 - its quarry and the two enemies close beside it (farther with Area) - for +10% damage. +1 Arcane tag.

cards.name: Hound of Annwn
cards.description: It becomes a white hound of the otherworld, red-eared: every bite lands 120% harder with jaws 50% wider, it goes for an elite or a boss first when one is near you, and a bite on one lands 2 times over.

cards.name: Pyroclasm
cards.description: Impact leaves a pool of burning magma that scorches ground for 3 seconds.

cards.name: Cluster Bombs
cards.description: Each blast throws out 3 bomblets that burst just past its edge for half damage.

cards.name: Iron Comet
cards.description: The fireball is forged around an iron core: +1 Metal tag, and the first hit Withers 5% of an enemy's max HP.

cards.name: Hellfire Nova
cards.description: Detonates in a colossal flame shockwave (+150% Area, +100% Damage).

cards.name: Armageddon Sun
cards.description: A slow, swollen sun that bursts for +150% Damage and +100% Area.

cards.name: Ice Statues
cards.description: The dead freeze where they fall: each stands a moment as a statue of ice, then breaks, shattering a second time for 60%. +1 Ice tag.

cards.name: Ice Flurry
cards.description: Every shatter flings 2 shards of ice out at the enemies just beyond it; each flies to its enemy and strikes and chills it.

cards.name: Frost Nova Burst
cards.description: The shatter freezes what it catches solid for 1.0s instead of slowing it.

cards.name: Avalanche
cards.description: Enemies killed by a shatter shatter too, a moment later - up to 3 times in a row - so one kill ripples out through the whole pack. +60% damage.

cards.name: Meltwater
cards.description: Every corpse melts into a pool of meltwater for 4s, and the next shatter to reach a pool freezes it: it bursts into spikes of ice under whatever stands in it, for 150% of a shatter. +100% damage, and +1 Water tag.

cards.name: Eddy
cards.description: At the end of its throw the blade hangs in an eddy for 0.6s, swelling and spinning, cutting everything round it again and again before it comes home. +25% damage.

cards.name: Hooked Throw
cards.description: The blade comes home on a wide hook instead of back along its throw, cutting a second path through the pack. +10% critical strike chance.

cards.name: Live Wire
cards.description: A crackling wire of lightning runs from your hand to the blade while it flies, and cuts whatever it crosses for 35% of a cut every 0.2s. The blade flies 20% faster.

cards.name: Thunderhead
cards.description: Each time the blade turns, lightning strikes where it hangs: everything near takes 280% of a cut and is staggered. Every cut +15%.

cards.name: Squall
cards.description: At the end of its throw the blade bursts into 5, and all of them come home by different paths, each cutting for 75%. -20% cooldown.

cards.name: Shatter
cards.description: As each spike withdraws it bursts into a ring of 6 ice splinters that fly out past it, each striking the first enemy in its way for 50% of the spike's damage. +20% damage.

cards.name: Spike Run
cards.description: The spikes stop scattering: they race along the ground across the front of the pack, one after another, the middle one under the target - and 2 more join the run.

cards.name: Rimefoot
cards.description: Every spike leaves the ground it rose from frozen for 3 s: whatever crosses the ice is slowed 45%. +20% damage.

cards.name: Glacier Crown
cards.description: 12 more spikes erupt in a ring round the target and stand 1.5 s: the pack inside is penned, turned back from the ice whichever way it walks, and the crown strikes everything in and on it once. Every spike +150% damage.

cards.name: Frozen Spire
cards.description: The spike under the target rises twice as tall, reaches 40% wider and stands 5 s as a pillar of ice: whatever touches it is struck for 50% and frozen 0.8 s. -40% cooldown, every spike +80% damage.

cards.name: Bone Spikes
cards.description: When a grave springs it spits its bones out: 8 shards of bone fly out past the collapse, each striking the first enemy in its way for 50% of the collapse's damage. +20% damage.

cards.name: Quickset
cards.description: Graves tear open at once, already armed, earth flung off them, hard in front of each enemy coming: the first to tread on one springs it. Graves are dug 30% more often.

cards.name: Grave Chill
cards.description: What the grave holds is chilled to the bone, its breath smoking cold: Weakened (-30% damage dealt) while held and 2.5 s after. +20% damage.

cards.name: Mass Grave
cards.description: One great grave a cast, opened under the front of the swarm: its bank twice as wide, its collapse 2.2 times as wide, holding what it takes 0.6 s longer and draining it for 30% every 0.35 s while it does. +80% damage.

cards.name: Grave Line
cards.description: The graves are dug in a line along the ground you just crossed - a minefield behind you for whatever follows - or, when you stand your ground, in a line out toward what is coming. 3 more graves a cast, dug twice as often, +80% damage.

cards.name: Crush
cards.description: The collapse crushes the knot by its own weight: +2% damage for every enemy caught in it, up to +30% at 15. The core swells as the knot fills.

cards.name: Twin Stars
cards.description: Two wells open on two packs at once and drift together as they pull, tethered, dragging both knots into one for both collapses to land on. Each drags 15% harder, +30% damage.

cards.name: Eclipse
cards.description: The well burns with a corona: +20% damage, +1 Light tag, and hits Weaken enemies (-30% damage dealt) for 3 s.

cards.name: Black Sun
cards.description: The star does not go out: it pulls and collapses 3 times before it fades, and a mote circles its core for each collapse it has left. Half again as wide, +60% damage.

cards.name: Nova Seed
cards.description: Each collapse throws 3 shards of the star at the nearest packs outside it, and each opens a smaller well where it lands that knots that pack in turn. -40% cooldown, +20% damage.

cards.name: Heavy Draw
cards.description: A full draw looses heavier arrows that throw back and stagger what they hit. +30% damage.

cards.name: Running Shot
cards.description: While you run with the bow drawn, it looses a snap shot at the nearest enemy every few strides, for 60% of an arrow. The volley still comes when you stop. -15% time to nock, and arrows fly 25% faster.

cards.name: Barbed
cards.description: An arrow that stops in an enemy stays in it, and the wound bleeds 25% of the arrow's hit every 0.5s for 3s. +10% damage.

cards.name: Rain of Arrows
cards.description: The volley goes straight up and comes down as a field of arrows over the pack nearest where you stopped - 6 for every arrow you loose. +50% damage.

cards.name: Hunter's Mark
cards.description: A full draw marks the strongest enemy in reach - the whole volley seeks it, and for 5s it takes 25% more from everything. -50% time to nock, +3 arrows a volley, +4 pierce, and every arrow +60% damage.

cards.name: Spiked Rail
cards.description: A spiked rail runs along the stakes: what touches the wall is thrown back 80% harder and bleeds for 2s, 25% of a cut every half second. +20% damage, and the wall is 15% longer.

cards.name: Caltrops
cards.description: When the wall comes down, its stakes break into caltrops strewn on its far side for 3.5s, cutting what walks over them for 75% and slowing it 50%. -25% cooldown.

cards.name: Lightning Rod
cards.description: The stakes draw lightning: +20% damage, +1 Lightning tag, and hits stagger for 0.25 s.

cards.name: Iron Ring
cards.description: The stakes close into a ring round the nearest pack: what is inside is shoved back in, what is outside kept out, and whatever leans on the stakes is cut. +150% damage.

cards.name: Rolling Wall
cards.description: Once raised, the wall marches forward at a walk, shoving the pack ahead of it and cutting it as it goes, until it meets water or a wall. Two more walls a cast toward other packs, each stands 1s longer, -50% cooldown, +30% damage.

cards.name: Flare
cards.description: The first time a ward meets the pack it flares: a burst of light 1.6 times as wide as its burn, for 2x a strike. +20% damage.

cards.name: Wisp Trail
cards.description: A drifting ward sheds wisps of its light behind it: each hangs where it was left for 2.5s and sears whatever walks into it for 50% of a strike every half second. Wards drift 25% faster.

cards.name: Rimelight
cards.description: The ward burns cold: +20% damage, +1 Ice tag, and hits slow by 30% for 1.5 s.

cards.name: Pyre
cards.description: Every ward burns as a pyre twice as wide - a small sun drifting into the pack. +80% damage.

cards.name: Kindling Flock
cards.description: The wards no longer drift off: they circle you as a flock, each breaking off to burn whatever comes near and flying back to its place. 3 more may burn at once, each lasts 3s longer, -50% cooldown, +80% damage.

cards.name: Twin Volley
cards.description: The missile forks on its first hit, spraying two shards straight out to either side for 30% damage.

cards.name: Threaded Needle
cards.description: The missile threads the pack: after each hit it turns on the nearest enemy it has not struck and flies on, 3 more times, stitching a thread of stardust through them.

cards.name: Unstable Detonation
cards.description: Missiles detonate where they hit: an arcane burst throws sparks out round the impact, hitting everything in it for 60% damage.

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.description: Every missile leaves a spark of static crackling round what it hits, and an enemy carrying 3 overloads: lightning bursts out of it, striking it and everything round it for 3x a missile. Missiles loosed 40% faster.

cards.name: Arcane Orb
cards.description: Every missile is loosed as a great slow orb of arcane light that rolls straight through the pack, striking everything under it 5 times a second, and bursts where its flight ends for 200% of a missile. +50% damage, 50% longer cooldown.

cards.name: Meteor Shower
cards.description: Spawns +3 meteors per volley with +30% impact area.

cards.name: Magma Craters
cards.description: Impacts leave burning lava craters that incinerate ground for 4s.

cards.name: Cosmic Impact
cards.description: Increases direct impact damage by +75%, and the impact throws enemies back.

cards.name: Extinction Event
cards.description: Every meteor is a colossal impact: +250% Damage and three times the blast.

cards.name: Orbital Bombardment
cards.description: Continuous non-stop rain of burning stars (-60% Cooldown, +6 Meteors).

cards.name: Sucking Mud
cards.description: The first enemy to wade into each pool is held there for 1 s, the mud heaped round its feet, while the bog bites. +20% damage.

cards.name: Broad Wake
cards.description: Every stride lays its pool with two smaller ones beside it, so the bog spreads three pools across behind you.

cards.name: Fen Gas
cards.description: The bog breathes: each pool lets up a cloud of marsh gas every few seconds that hangs 2.2 s and poisons whatever is under it for as much as a bite of the bog.

cards.name: Great Bog
cards.description: Stop, and the bog round you spreads into one marsh 3 pools wide that drags everything in it to a crawl, and keeps welling up while you stand. Walking, the pools are 40% wider and bite 60% harder.

cards.name: Will-o'-Wisps
cards.description: Marsh lights rise out of the pools and go hunting: each flies at the nearest enemy and breaks on it for 2.5 bites of the bog. The trail holds 5 more pools, each lingering 1.5 s longer, laid 30% closer. Every bite +50% damage.

cards.name: Slag Trail
cards.description: The shard's flight leaves a line of burning slag for 2s, and whatever crosses it burns for 30% of a hit every 0.4s. +20% damage.

cards.name: Splitting Shard
cards.description: On its first hit the shard splits in two, and each half homes on a new enemy for 65% of the hit. -20% cooldown, and shards fly 25% faster.

cards.name: Magma Core
cards.description: The shard lodges in what it hits, glowing hotter, and erupts 0.8s later for 130% of the hit on everything round it.

cards.name: Caldera
cards.description: The shard dives into the ground where it strikes, and a pool of lava wells up there for 4s, burning everything in it for 45% of a hit twice a second. +60% damage.

cards.name: Forge Swarm
cards.description: Shards gather in a ring round you as they are forged, and when it holds 8 they all launch at once, each at a different enemy. -50% cooldown, 4 forged a cast, +4 pierce, 40% larger.

cards.name: Splinter Field
cards.description: The eruption splinters through the ground: as its cracks run out, a splinter of glass punches up under each of the 4 nearest enemies just past its rim, one after another, striking what stands over it for 50% of the spike. The eruption 15% wider.

cards.name: Umbral Vein
cards.description: Black glass drinks the light: +1 Darkness tag, and hits leave enemies Vulnerable (+10% damage taken) for 3 s.

cards.name: Deep Strata
cards.description: The spike is driven up from far deeper and throws everything it breaks out under up into the air: for 0.6 s they hang there and do nothing, then drop where they were. Elites and bosses are too heavy to throw and reel instead. +40% damage, and it reaches farther.

cards.name: Tectonic Uprising
cards.description: The ground does not close: where each spike broke out a vent stays open for 3 s, its cracks smouldering, and every 0.5 s it throws up a fresh spike of glass under the nearest enemy that comes near it, for 60% of the spike. +80% damage, the eruption 30% wider.

cards.name: Basalt Lance
cards.description: The spike is forged rather than grown - a needle of volcanic glass: +140% damage, and it drives on through the crowd behind its target, 3 more spikes in a line.

cards.name: Breaker
cards.description: The wave throws everything it breaks over back along its run. +35% damage, and a wave 30% bigger.

cards.name: Groundswell
cards.description: The wave builds as it runs - it leaves your hand at 60% of its size and breaks at 180% at the end of its run. -25% cooldown, and it runs 25% faster.

cards.name: Brackish Tide
cards.description: The surge runs brackish: +20% damage, +1 Poison tag, and hits poison for 3 dmg/s over 3 s.

cards.name: Tidal Wall
cards.description: The wave rises into a wall of water three times as wide, +60% damage, and it breaks through 40 more before it is spent.

cards.name: Trident
cards.description: Three waves fan out from your hand at once, the middle one on your aim and the others 24 degrees to either side. -50% cooldown, and each wave 40% bigger, 40% harder and tearing through 4 more.

cards.name: Flashpoint
cards.description: Every ray bursts where it strikes, scorching what stands beside its target for 50% of its damage, and the hotter the ray the wider the burst: a target held to full heat flashes over in a blast 60% wider, at the ray's full damage. +20% damage.

cards.name: Handoff
cards.description: A ray whose target falls swings on to the nearest enemy and burns it as hot as it was, once a cast, and holds that heat on it into the next. Rays strike 25% faster.

cards.name: Burn Through
cards.description: The beam runs on through its target to the edge of the screen, burning every enemy on its line. +15% damage.

cards.name: Prism
cards.description: Every ray splits where it strikes into 4 rays that burn the enemies round its target, each for 80% of the ray, its heat and all - and they stay that hot into the next cast. +60% damage.

cards.name: Sunlance
cards.description: Every ray widens into a lance that stays lit after it strikes and sweeps on to the next enemy, and the next, burning everything it crosses - wider the hotter it burns. -30% cooldown.

cards.name: Black Sigil
cards.description: Everything the curse touches wears a black sigil at its feet, and the next hit it takes from any of your other spells breaks it in a burst of shadow that lays the curse on everything near and strikes for 4x the bolt. +12% damage taken.

cards.name: Creeping Rot
cards.description: Every arc sinks into the ground as a path of rot that lies 2.5s, poisoning, slowing and exposing whatever crosses it. Deeper poison and a heavier drag.

cards.name: Spreading Dark
cards.description: The curse forks at every jump - two arcs leave each enemy it reaches - and runs two hops further. No extra damage.

cards.name: Anathema
cards.description: Where the curse ends, night falls: a pall of darkness hangs over the last enemy it reached for 3s, cursing and striking everything under it every half second. +20% damage taken, two hops further, and the curse bites 45% harder.

cards.name: Threefold Curse
cards.description: 3 curses leave the staff at once, each at its own enemy and each chaining on its own, and the rot they carry does real damage. +20% damage.

cards.name: Deep Rime
cards.description: The runes are cut deeper in the cold: +35% damage, and each passes through 1 more enemy. +1 Ice tag.

cards.name: Rune Flurry
cards.description: +2 runes every cast.

cards.name: Far Wind
cards.description: Runes fly 30% faster and 32% farther.

cards.name: Sigil Fan
cards.description: Every cast leaves at once, fanned across 50 degrees: +3 runes, and each passes through 1 more enemy.

cards.name: Turning Gale
cards.description: A rune that reaches the end of its flight is turned back to you by the wind, and pierces again on the way home. +35% damage, +1 Wind tag.

cards.name: Sun Dogs
cards.description: Two mock suns hang either side of you and flare with every pulse, each 60% as wide as the flare, for 60% of its damage - and as the flare builds while you stand still they drift farther out. Pulses 20% faster.

cards.name: Solar Prominence
cards.description: Every pulse hurls 2 loops of fire off the flare's rim - one more at half charge, another at full - that arc over and come down on the nearest enemies past its edge, each bursting for 80% of the pulse. +1 Fire tag, +15% damage, 12% slower pulses.

cards.name: Blinding Flash
cards.description: Some of what the flare catches reels away blind: 30% of it is staggered 0.4 s and thrown back out of the light.

cards.name: Daybreak Avatar
cards.description: A flare that fills the clearing and burns away every enemy bolt that enters it: +100% Area, +100% Damage, for 12% slower pulses.

cards.name: Corona Discharge
cards.description: Every pulse throws 8 sunbeams far past the flare, each cutting everything along it, and +140% damage.

cards.name: Broadaxe
cards.description: A broader blade: the cleave reaches 25% wider and every blow hits 10% harder.

cards.name: Headsman
cards.description: The axe goes for the wounded: a blow on an enemy under half its health deals double.

cards.name: Dawnsplitter
cards.description: The axe burns with dawn-light: its hits Weaken enemies (-30% damage dealt) for 3 s.

cards.name: Executioner's Greataxe
cards.description: The axe becomes a colossal double-bitted greataxe, twice the size: it cleaves twice as wide and throws what it hits twice as far.

cards.name: Whirling Axes
cards.description: Two more axes, spinning end over end between blows: three heavy blows where there was one.

cards.name: Aftershock
cards.description: The ground answers every slam: 0.4 s later a second shockwave runs out 40% wider for 60% damage, and slows again.

cards.name: Earthshaker
cards.description: A heavier head: every slam reaches 35% wider and slows 15% harder.

cards.name: Hallowed Ground
cards.description: Every slam leaves the ground hallowed for 2.5 s: whatever stands in it is Weakened (-30% damage dealt) and slowed.

cards.name: Titan's Maul
cards.description: The hammer becomes a colossal maul, twice the size: its slam reaches twice as wide, hits 20% harder and stops what it hits dead for 0.5 s.

cards.name: Hammerfall
cards.description: Two more hammers, falling in turn so the ground never stops shaking. Every slam hits 15% harder.

cards.name: Twin Blades
cards.description: A second sword joins the first and hunts its own quarry. Every sword strikes 10% softer.

cards.name: Riposte
cards.description: Each sword's guard reaches 60% further, and every bolt it parries hands it a strike at once. Strikes hit 30% harder.

cards.name: Soul Siphon
cards.description: Every strike heals you 1 HP, at most 3 HP a second.

cards.name: Celestial Greatsword
cards.description: The sword becomes a colossal greatsword of light, twice the size. Its stroke cuts every enemy along the blade as it falls, not only its quarry, and hits 30% harder.

cards.name: Thousand Cuts
cards.description: Every swing becomes a flurry of three cuts, each at 85%. A cut whose quarry has fallen goes to the nearest enemy.

cards.name: Shooting Stars
cards.description: Every third star streaks in low across the whole rain instead of falling: a line of light from rim to rim that strikes everything it crosses for 80% of a star. +10% damage, +1 Light tag.

cards.name: Frostfall
cards.description: The stars fall cold: +20% damage, +1 Ice tag, and hits slow by 30% for 1.5 s.

cards.name: Skipping Stars
cards.description: Every star lands at its slant and skips on twice, like a stone across water: the first skip lands 55% as hard and 75% as wide, the second 35% and 55%.

cards.name: Starburst
cards.description: Each star lands, swells for 0.3s and explodes 120% wider for +110% damage, throwing 3 sparks that land past its rim as small stars (40% damage). Stars fall half as often. +1 Light tag.

cards.name: Constellation
cards.description: Each star stays lit where it fell for 2.5s, joined to the nearest lit star by a line of light; every 0.5s the lines strike all they touch for 55% of a star's damage. +1 star every cloudburst, and every star hits twice as hard.

cards.name: High Voltage
cards.description: The storm runs hotter: +30% damage, and every sweep reaches 20% further and wider. +1 Lightning tag.

cards.name: Iron Current
cards.description: The storm runs through iron: +20% damage, +1 Metal tag, and the first hit Withers 5% of an enemy's max HP.

cards.name: Rapid Discharge
cards.description: 30% shorter cooldown, and every sweep crackles through 25% faster.

cards.name: Thunderclap
cards.description: Every arc sweeps twice, down and back up, and each pass ends in a thunderclap at its far end that hits everything around it (a wider clap with Area) for 80% of the sweep's damage. +1 Lightning tag.

cards.name: Cardinal Storm
cards.description: Every sweep goes all four ways at once - left, right, up and down - but comes 25% less often.

cards.name: Barbed Lash
cards.description: The thorns break off in what the vine cuts: for 4 s, every few steps a barbed enemy walks tears it open again for 35% of the lash, and leaves a splash of sap behind it.

cards.name: Snapback
cards.description: The whip cracks out and back: after every lash it tears free and sweeps the same arc again the other way, cutting through as many again.

cards.name: Entangle
cards.description: The vine coils round the feet of everything it cuts and roots it for 0.6 s. +20% damage.

cards.name: Thicket
cards.description: Where the whip lands, thorny brambles grow across the whole arc it swept and stand 3 s, the newest 2 at a time: whatever is in them is cut for 40% of the lash every 0.5 s, poisoned and slowed 40%. The vine reaches 30% farther and lashes 60% harder.

cards.name: Hydra Vine
cards.description: One root bursts up in the thick of the pack and splits into 3 heads, 20% longer, each lashing its own third of the ring round it - the pack whipped from the inside. -40% cooldown, and each head cuts through 2 more.

cards.name: Lingering Rot
cards.description: Each burst leaves a spore cloud as wide as itself for 3.5s that keeps poisoning anything inside. Poison +1 per tick.

cards.name: Ember Caps
cards.description: The spores trade Poison for Fire: bursts hit 50% harder and light 4 patches for 2.5s that burn for 30% of the burst every half second.

cards.name: Giant Caps
cards.description: Two fewer mushrooms, and each takes 67% longer to swell - but bursts 60% wider for +80% damage. Cooldown +20%.

cards.name: Doomcap
cards.description: One titanic Doomcap grows in place of the scatter for 2.6s, then bursts 180% wider. Every mushroom it replaces adds 15% damage (x1.9 at six), and +65% more on top. Cooldown +40%.

cards.name: Mycelial Bloom
cards.description: Every burst sends mycelium out: 2 more mushrooms sprout past its rim, swell twice as fast and burst at 80% of its size for half damage, and each of those sprouts 1 more. Every burst +85% damage.

cards.name: Abyssal Scar
cards.description: As the lance withdraws it tears a scar of void into the ground along its line that stays 2s, cutting whatever stands on it for 40% of the lance every 0.4s.

cards.name: Void Glaive
cards.description: The lance runs out of both hands: with every cast a second blade, 75% as long, thrusts out behind you along the same line.

cards.name: Dread
cards.description: Everything the lance runs through is struck with dread and turns and runs from you for 1.6s (elites and bosses stand firm). +20% damage, and +1 Darkness tag.

cards.name: Witching Hour
cards.description: The lance no longer withdraws: it stays in your hands and turns round you like the hand of a clock, once every 2.6s, cutting everything it sweeps across. +1 Arcane tag.

cards.name: Cosmic Collapse
cards.description: The lance ends in a black hole: at its tip a disc of void swells and caves in on itself, bursting over everything round it (+140% Damage, +120% Area).

cards.name: Cataclysm
cards.description: Whatever the flame kills leaves a burning crater, and anything that dies in a crater opens another. The crowd is the fuel.

cards.name: The Long Winter
cards.description: The cone opens into a full ring that freezes everything it touches solid. The frozen shatter when they die, and the shards freeze their neighbours.

cards.name: The Lattice
cards.description: The chain stops ending. Everything it strikes stays linked for a few seconds, and the web keeps discharging along its own edges.

cards.name: Sundering
cards.description: Each cast shoves everything near you back and raises a broken ring of obsidian around you. Inside it you take less from every hit.

cards.name: Spring Tide
cards.description: Every wave leaves the ground behind it flooded. The current drags whatever stands in it along the wave's path and will not let it walk.

cards.name: Wildwood
cards.description: A patch that finishes growing throws three seeds around itself, so every planting becomes a thicket.

cards.name: The Spirit Mirror
cards.description: The well opens half again as wide and drags harder. When it closes, every XP orb, potion and flask inside its reach is pulled to you.

cards.name: The Endless Chase
cards.description: The whirlwind catches every enemy bolt that comes into it and throws it back at the nearest enemy, three times as hard as a blade cuts.
